notes: AVENTOS HK-S (printed pp. 56-57) and HK-XS (pp. 62-64) stay lifts from the Blum Catalogue and technical manual 2024/2025. LF = KH x FG including double the handle weight; the stronger mechanism where ranges overlap. HK-S: a set of two unsprung mechanisms, front fixed with 2 x 175H3100; inside height at least 150 mm, inside depth 163 mm (read from the space requirement drawing). Blum allows +50 % LF with a third HK-S mechanism (not chosen automatically). HK-XS: one mechanism, or one each side for double the LF, on CLIP top 110 hinges (70T3550.TL unsprung recommended) with 175H3100 plates: 2 hinges, 3 from KB 900 or LF 1800, 4 from KB 1200 or LF 2700. Side drilling (pp. 57, 64) is not recorded yet. Not verified by a person.
